vendor/gx3d.js        three.js 0.160.0 (MIT licence) with GLTFLoader, RoomEnvironment and DecalGeometry, bundled into one file that sets window.GX3D.
vendor/gx3d-player.js the 3D player viewer (window.gxPl3D.mount) used by test3d.html and, once approved, the Lines player popup.
models3d/standing_*.glb lighter copies of hockey_standing_MASTER.glb (Meshy model from Kuvar): hi 123k triangles, mid 44k, low 10.6k; textures 2048/1024/512 WebP, positions quantized. The original is not in the repo.
